recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Any future revisit of the historical DAF/US Core snapshot output should happen in the relevant historical publication, external IG, or tooling context rather than in current FHIR core source.
issue_request: FHIR-5580 reported that generated snapshots for observation-daf-vitalsigns and observation-daf-smokingstatus did not reflect differential constraints on Observation.referenceRange: max stayed '*' instead of 1 or 0, and mustSupport=true was missing.
initial_application: The Jira comments state that Grahame Grieve fixed the issue as part of an earlier element re-ordering fix. No FHIR-5580-tagged commit was found, but January 2015 history shows profile-generation and validation work, including 94b5523be3 touching ProfileUtilities/ProfileGenerator and the affected DAF Observation profile spreadsheets.
additional_context: The affected profiles were historical DSTU1/DAF artifacts. Current source/fhir.ini has no active DAF profile entry, the us-core profile entry is commented out, and current tracked DAF remnants are terminology/value set files rather than the generated observation-daf snapshots named by the Jira. Current Observation.referenceRange remains the unconstrained base element, which is not the profile-specific generated snapshot error described by the issue.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. No current build-scoped FHIR-core source file needs correction for FHIR-5580.

related_jiras.note: Earlier Published issue reported the same DAF vital-signs differential/snapshot mismatch for referenceRange must-support.
Related Published tooling-validation issue for DAF profile problems, broader than the snapshot/differential mismatch audited here.
